limitations: Real normally built production UI in native Chromium; official synthetic Gateway supplies skill library fixtures and records only synthetic writes. No real skills/files, external channel, model or production Gateway changed.

Chromium CDP Input.imeSetComposition creates an actual browser IME composition; Playwright keyboard sends the ordinary Ctrl+Enter shortcut. Event observation records actual isTrusted/isComposing without manufacturing flags or calling product owners.
This proves Chromium behavior only, not macOS/Windows IME or WebKit platform compatibility.
